english.title: Responsible person fail to alter the dimensions / mesh size and placement of an eel screen in a diversion structure
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an owner, occupier or person in charge of land at **(..SPECIFY LAND..), who had been served with a notice on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF SERVICE OF NOTICE..) under regulation 17(5)(b) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009, failed, at your own cost, to alter the dimensions and the placement of an eel screen placed under regulation 17(4) of those regulations to those specified in the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(5)(b), (6)(a) and 28(1) of the Eels (England and Wales) Regulations 2009.
